fields.statement: ArgentSea Core's published package declares exactly these external dependencies, at these pinned versions: Microsoft.CSharp 4.7.0, Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration 10.0.13, Microsoft.Extensions.Logging 10.0.13, Microsoft.Extensions.Options 10.0.13, Microsoft.Extensions.Options.ConfigurationExtensions 10.0.13, Polly 8.8.0, and System.Collections.Immutable 10.0.13. Polly is the package's only non-Microsoft dependency; it is the resilience library (retry and circuit-breaking) that ArgentSea Core's platform-neutral resilient command execution is implemented on top of.
fields.scope: ArgentSea Core NuGet package dependency declarations (ArgentSea.Shared/src/ArgentSea.csproj PackageReference items).
